project.name: VisaPathFinder
project.repositoryState: As of 2026-10-06, the project is a functioning static visa reference app with a passing typecheck/lint check and a basic Vitest baseline for tracker utilities.

overview.summary: A TanStack Start visa reference site that serves static country, visa, embassy, comparison, and tracker pages.
goals: Provide a local-only visa application tracker.

businessContext.purpose: Reference product for visa research and trip-planning support.
businessModelSignals: Site copy describes the product as free and ad-supported.

architecture.style: SSR React application with file-based routing and static TypeScript data modules.
architecture.rendering: Server-rendered with client and server bundles.
architecture.dataSource: Static in-repo TypeScript modules under src/data.
architecture.serverWrapper: src/server.ts adds canonical redirects, HSTS, and SSR error fallback handling.

implementedFeatures: Home page with country search and discovery sections.
Visa detail pages with checklist, sources, and JSON-LD.
Embassy dataset reviewed and refreshed against official/public sources on 2026-08-05.
Pairwise country comparison pages for all current country combinations.
Pair-specific compare-page narrative system generated from country profiles and pair briefs.
Browser-local visa tracker with share-link support.
Structured SEO metadata and sitemap generation.
Static robots, redirects, and security headers.
Ad slot component with optional AdSense script loading.
completedMilestones: Static content model established for the current 7-country scope.
SSR route set implemented for all visible product areas.
Long-form compare-content system added to the working tree.
Compare-page similarity reduced materially versus the legacy template according to the local comparison script run on 2026-08-05.
Tracker feature implemented without account requirements.

currentModules.name: Content data layer
currentModules.notes: Static TypeScript modules drive all user-facing content, including embassy records refreshed on 2026-08-05.

currentModules.name: Country and visa routes
currentModules.notes: Country hubs and route-level visa pages are wired and SEO-decorated.

currentModules.name: Comparison engine
currentModules.notes: Uses compare country profiles, pair briefs, generated page content, FAQ generation, and route-link generation.

currentModules.name: Server function example
currentModules.notes: Example createServerFn exists but is not wired into product behavior.

apiEndpoints.notes: Returns XML sitemap from a route server handler.
Example server function exists in source but no importing route/component was found.

database.schema: No database schema found. Domain structure is defined in TypeScript interfaces and static content modules.

authentication.notes: No login, session, role, or protected-route system found.

integrations.name: Google AdSense
integrations.status: conditionally enabled via public env var

deployment.workflow: GitHub Actions deploy workflow publishes dist to Cloudflare Pages project visapath.
deployment.wrangler: wrangler.jsonc targets visapathfinder using dist/server/server.js plus dist/client assets.
deployment.status: mixed deployment configuration; production target not fully unified in repo docs/config.

commands.notes: Production client and SSR bundles built successfully; Vite still reported a large client chunk warning.
TypeScript and ESLint both completed successfully after formatting cleanup.
Vitest baseline is passing for tracker utility coverage (4 tests).
Compare-content similarity script completed successfully on the current working tree.

environment.notes: No required server-only secret configuration was found in active feature code.

knownIssues: Cloudflare deployment path is still split between GitHub Pages workflow and Wrangler config.
Build still emits large client chunk warnings.
The repo is still static-data driven and would need a managed content layer if country coverage expands significantly.
technicalDebt: Optional cleanup of the example server-function scaffold if it remains unused.
React Query is initialized without active query-driven data fetching.
Static data and comparison content will become harder to maintain as country coverage grows.
Compare and tracker routes contribute to large bundles.
Deployment target should be formally standardized for the production environment.
nextPriorities: Add route-level smoke tests for home, visa, compare, and tracker pages.
Standardize the deployment story and decide on a single Cloudflare production target.
Review bundle splitting for large client chunks and optimize heavy compare/tracker pages.
Strengthen content validation and source-data workflow for future country additions.
Reassess whether a managed backend is needed once the static content model outgrows current scope.
futureScope: Continue static content expansion with stronger validation and structured source tracking.
Add more automated regression coverage before major refactors.
If growth accelerates, introduce a managed content backend or CMS workflow.
